item.text:
I made [Star Garden](/workspace/star-garden.html), a little interactive night sky.

Open it in your browser. Click or drag to plant stars, watch them connect, and save your sky as a PNG. Works offline, with reduced-motion support.

Control logic checks passed; browser visuals haven’t been verified.
